svg.aria-label: Diagram of the human resources pack's record types. Four structured types across the top: employee, carrying a national identity number, a birth date drawn from an eighteen to sixty five age window, and a manager name that is a lexicon draw rather than a reference; position history, one to three per employee; leave record, whose type column is a structured enum carrying no label at all; and payroll entry, twelve per employee per year, with a labeled anomaly kind. Three document types below in red, each producing a label sidecar: performance note and hr request, both pointing at an employee, and recruiter note, which deliberately points at nothing because its subject is a candidate rather than an employee. Two bands across the bottom state the boundaries this pack holds: health stays at category granularity with no diagnosis, treatment, medication or prognosis; and the criminal record surface stays procedural, recording that a document was requested, received or is pending, never what it contains.
svg.title: What the human resources pack emits
svg.desc: Four structured record types, three document types, and the two boundaries this pack holds stated across the bottom.
